This part of the workflow should only be run when we want to update our base screenshots.

parameters.content:
## 2. Generate Webpage Screenshot via Apify
[Learn more about Apify.com]({{ $env.API_BASE_URL }}

To generate a screenshot of the webpage, we'll need a third party service since this functionality is outside the scope of n8n. Feel free to pick whichever internal or external service works for you but I've had great experience using [Apify.com]({{ $env.API_BASE_URL }} - a popular webscraping SaaS who offer a generous free plan and require very little configuration to get started.

The Apify "actor" (ie. a type of scraper) we'll be using is specifically designed to take webpage screenshots.

parameters.text: Identify changes between the base image and test image.

messageValues.message:
=You help with visual regression testing for websites. Identify changes to text content, images, colors, position and layouts of the elements in the screenshots. Ignore text styling or casing changes.
The first image will be the base image and the second image will be the test. Note all changes to the test image which differ from the base. If there are no changes, it is okay to return an empty array.
